readbacks.en: Let $u,v$ be arbitrary universe levels. A supplied record $A$ assigns to every field $k$ in universe $u$ a type $O_k$, to each pair of objects a type of covers, and a composition operation on composable covers. Each field homomorphism gives base change of objects and covers. Every elliptic Weierstrass curve gives an object, and pmQuotient is a supplied operation on objects. Each object has an assigned profinite group, and each cover has an assigned continuous group homomorphism that is an open embedding. There are supplied predicates on squares of covers, pairs of objects (HasCore), and two predicates on natural numbers and objects. Each object has a supplied cusp type, with cusp base change. Over every complete field with a rank-one valuation valued in the multiplicative integers with zero, there are a supplied type of Tate structures on an object and a predicate of a natural number, an object and a Tate structure. Each object and natural number have an assigned rank-one quotient type with a map to the cusps. A supplied record $G$ over $A$ assigns to each object a group, a topology and a continuous homomorphism to its assigned profinite group; over each complete rank-one valued field as above it also assigns a predicate of a natural number, an object and an $A$-Tate structure, and a chosen cusp for each such object and structure. These types, maps and predicates are record fields, with no extra geometric or functoriality assumptions. A datum X of type Corollary312VariantData consists of an InitialThetaData record D, a record Q and a record R. In D, F is a number field, Fbar is an algebraic closure of F, E is an elliptic Weierstrass curve over F, M=Q(E.j) is the intermediate field generated by its j-invariant, and Vbad is a nonempty set of finite places of M with odd residue characteristic; -1 is a square in F, E has stable reduction at every finite place of F, its 6-torsion over Fbar is rational over F, and it has multiplicative reduction at every place of F over Vbad. The chosen prime ell is at least 5; a chosen additive basis identifies its torsion with (Z/ell Z)^2, and the Galois representation realizes the action in that basis, has open kernel and contains the image of SL_2(Z/ell Z). F/M is Galois of degree coprime to ell, and ell is coprime to every residue characteristic in Vbad. At every bad place of F the record supplies a Tate parameter having the embedded j-invariant of E, a uniformizer, and the condition that its positive integral q-order is coprime to ell. K is the fixed field of that representation's kernel. D also includes the number-field and compatible M-algebra/tower structures on K, the TateFamily over K with its two Galois-equivariance conditions, and its OrbicurveData and LocalThetaData: a specified cartesian diagram of covers with the two stated type predicates and core predicate, a rank-one-quotient bijection with Z/ell Z, a chosen quotient with nonzero image and its specified cusp, sections of finite and infinite places lying over M, the base-changed cartesian diagrams, closed decomposition subgroups, the two local Tate structures, the stated local type and theta-model predicates, and the prescribed equality of cusps. These are carried data and conditions. Q chooses exactly the finite places of F over Vbad as a finite set Bq and assigns real weights a_w>0 on Bq. Put q_w equal to the positive integral q-order furnished by D at w, r_w equal to its residue characteristic, Q_p=sum over w in Bq with r_w=p of a_w q_w log(r_w), and Qtotal=sum over w in Bq of a_w q_w log(r_w). No normalization of these Q-weights is stipulated. R supplies a container indexed by all places of K, a map to the rational places compatible with finite residue characteristics and sending infinite places to infinity, finite fibers, and a standard procession of length L=(ell-1)/2, where subtraction and division here are natural-number operations; its i-th label set is {0,...,i+1}, of size n_i=i+2. At rational place z the component index c is a function from that label set to the fiber above z, and its packet carrier is the dependent product T_iz=product over c of S_izc, where each S_izc is a supplied commutative ring with a topology and a specified subset J_izc. In particular these carriers are the supplied products of rings, not an implicitly chosen local field. The integral region is J_iz=product over c of J_izc. A hull region is a set product over c of b_c J_izc with each b_c a unit. The supplied log-shell sets are product regions with compact closure, equal to J_iz away from finitely many z, and contain J_iz at finite z. For each i,z a hull system supplies a class of admissible sets with compact closure, a subclass H_iz of hull regions containing J_iz, and, for an admissible U, its least H_iz-member containing U, again admissible. R chooses a theta region Theta_iz, admissible for this system, inside the log-shell, and equal to J_iz away from finitely many z. Its chosen volume data give positive fiber weights summing to one, real component-volume functions and real packet-volume functions V_iz on arbitrary subsets of these carriers. Component volumes vanish on the finite integral subsets and on specified infinite balls; at a finite prime p the inverse image under multiplication by p of a unit multiple of an integral subset has component volume equal to the latter volume plus log(p). Packet volume vanishes on J_iz, and on a nonempty product region it is the finite sum of the component volumes weighted by the products of the fiber weights. Put HTheta_iz equal to the supplied least hull of Theta_iz and Rtotal=(sum over i<L of the finite-support sum over rational places z of V_iz(HTheta_iz))/L. The proposition Corollary312Variant(X) means exactly -Qtotal/(2 ell)≤Rtotal. For such an X, an invariant record inv chooses a natural number m with $1\le m\le[M:\mathbb Q]$, nonnegative real numbers D0 and F0, a finite set S of natural-number primes, and a function k:N→R with k(p)≥0 for every p and k(p)=0 outside S. These are the actual values of emod, logDtpd, logFtpd, dst and logDK; D0 and F0 are supplied numbers, with no further ideal or conductor definition in this record. Write d0=[M:Q] for X.dmod, e=552960m, a=log(e ell), j(p)=1 if p≤e ell and 0 otherwise, Ksum=sum_{p in S}k(p), and Slog=sum_{p in S}log(p). The certificate means all four conditions ell≥7, every r_w for w in Bq belongs to S, Ksum≤D0+F0+2log(ell)+21, and Slog≤2d0(D0+F0)+5+log(ell). Put b(n,p)=n k(p)-(n-1)^2 Q_p/(2ell)+log(p)+4n a j(p), where n is a natural number but n-1 in this formula is real subtraction. A local estimate is a choice of sets C_iz ⊆ T_iz for every i<L and rational place z such that C_iz belongs to H_iz, Theta_iz is a subset of C_iz, C_i,p=J_i,p for every finite prime p outside S, V_i,p(C_i,p)≤b(n_i,p) for every finite prime p in S, and V_i,infinity(C_i,infinity)≤n_i log(pi). It also requires, for all i,z and every pair of hull regions U,V in T_iz with U ⊆ V, that V_iz(U)≤V_iz(V); this monotonicity hypothesis is on every hull region, not only the chosen class H_iz. A prime-counting record consists of a real eta>1 with $\pi_{\mathbb N}(\lfloor t\rfloor_{\mathbb N})\le\frac{3t}{2\log t}$ for every real t≥eta, where pi_N(n) is the number of natural-number primes at most n and floor_nat is the nonnegative-integer floor. For every such A,G,X and inv, if a certificate cert and an actual local estimate est as described are supplied, if a prime-counting record with its chosen eta is supplied, and if Corollary312Variant(X), namely $-\frac{Q_{\mathrm{tot}}}{2\ell}\le R_{\mathrm{tot}}$, is assumed, then $\frac{Q_{\mathrm{tot}}}{6}\le\left(1+\frac{20d_0}{\ell}\right)(D_0+F_0)+20(e\ell+\eta)$. The theorem is universally quantified over these inputs; it neither constructs nor uniquely fixes them. All divisions in this conclusion are real divisions; the certificate makes ell≥7, so its denominators are nonzero. The finite set S is not required to be nonempty in its own record, although all certificate and X conditions must hold together.
readbacks.zh-Hans: 任取宇宙层级 $u,v$。给定记录 $A$，它对宇宙 $u$ 中的每个域 $k$ 指定对象类型 $O_k$，对每对对象指定覆盖类型，并给出可复合覆盖的复合运算。每个域同态给出对象和覆盖的基变换；每条椭圆 Weierstrass 曲线给出一个对象，pmQuotient 是对象上的指定运算。每个对象具有指定的副有限群，每个覆盖具有指定的连续群同态且该同态为开嵌入。覆盖方图、对象对（HasCore）、自然数与对象上的两个谓词均为给定谓词。每个对象具有指定尖点类型及其基变换。对每个带取值于乘法记号整数加零的秩一赋值且完备的域，给出对象的 Tate 结构类型及自然数、对象、这种结构上的谓词。每个对象和自然数具有指定秩一商类型及其到尖点的映射。给定 $A$ 上的记录 $G$，对每个对象指定群、拓扑及其到所给副有限群的连续同态；在上述完备秩一赋值域上，还指定自然数、对象、$A$ 的 Tate 结构上的谓词，以及每个带此结构对象的一个尖点。这些类型、映射与谓词均为记录字段，不添加额外几何条件或函子性条件。 Corollary312VariantData 类型的资料 X 由 InitialThetaData 记录 D、记录 Q、记录 R 组成。D 给出数域 F、F 的代数闭包 Fbar、F 上的椭圆 Weierstrass 曲线 E，令 M=Q(E.j) 为 j 不变量生成的中间域；还给出 M 的有限处的非空集合 Vbad，其中各处的剩余特征为奇数，-1 在 F 中是平方，E 在 F 的每个有限处具有稳定约化，在 Fbar 上的六阶挠点均来自 F，并在 Vbad 上方 F 的每个有限处具有乘法约化。所选素数 ell 至少为 5；所选加法基将其挠点群与 (Z/ell Z)^2 对应，所选 Galois 表示在此基下实现该作用，其核为开子群，像包含 SL_2(Z/ell Z) 的像。F/M 为次数与 ell 互素的 Galois 扩张，ell 与 Vbad 中每处的剩余特征互素。对 F 的每个坏处，记录给出 j 值等于 E 的 j 不变量嵌入值的 Tate 参数、素元，以及其正整数 q 阶与 ell 互素的条件。K 是该表示的核的不动域。D 还携带 K 的数域结构及相容的 M 代数和标量塔结构，K 上满足两个 Galois 等变条件的 TateFamily，以及 OrbicurveData 和 LocalThetaData；后两者给出满足两个类型谓词与核谓词的指定覆盖 Descartes 方图、秩一商到 Z/ell Z 的双射、在该双射下像非零的指定商及其尖点、在 M 上方的有限处和无限处截面、基变换后的 Descartes 方图、闭分解子群、两组局部 Tate 结构、指定局部类型与 theta 模型谓词，以及指定尖点等式。这些均为携带的数据和条件。Q 选取 F 中恰在 Vbad 上方的有限处组成的有限集合 Bq，并给出其上的正实权重 a_w。令 q_w 为 D 给出的正整数 q 阶，r_w 为剩余特征，Q_p 为对 Bq 中满足 r_w=p 的 w 求和的 a_w q_w log(r_w)，Qtotal 为对整个 Bq 求和的同一表达式；这些权重没有归一化条件。R 给出以 K 的所有处为指标的容器及到有理处的映射，有限处映射保持剩余特征，无限处映到无穷处；各纤维有限，并给出长度 L=(ell-1)/2 的标准序列，此处减法与除法取自然数运算，第 i 个标号集合为 {0,...,i+1}，大小 n_i=i+2。对每个有理处 z，分量指标 c 是从该标号集合到 z 上方纤维的函数，所给载体为依赖积 T_iz=product_c S_izc，每个 S_izc 是给定的带拓扑交换环，带指定子集 J_izc；因此载体实际是所给环的积。积分区域 J_iz=product_c J_izc；【译名待定：TERM-RMB-001】区域指形如 product_c b_c J_izc 且每个 b_c 为单位元的集合。所给对数壳是闭包紧的积区域，除有限多个 z 外等于 J_iz，且在有限处包含 J_iz。每个 i,z 的【译名待定：TERM-RMB-001】系统给出闭包紧的可容许集合类、包含 J_iz 的上述区域子类 H_iz，以及每个可容许 U 在 H_iz 中包含 U 的最小成员，此成员仍可容许。R 指定 theta 区域 Theta_iz，它可容许、包含于对数壳，且除有限多个 z 外等于 J_iz。体积资料给出每个纤维上和为 1 的正权重、实值分量体积函数及定义在载体任意子集上的实值函数 V_iz；分量体积在有限处的指定积分子集和无限处的指定球上为零，在有限素数 p 处，单位元乘积分子集在乘 p 映射下的原像，其分量体积等于该单位倍子集的体积加 log(p)。V_iz(J_iz)=0；对各分量均非空的积区域，V_iz 是以纤维权重的乘积为权的分量体积有限和。令 HTheta_iz 为 Theta_iz 的上述最小区域，令 Rtotal=(sum_{i<L} sum_z V_iz(HTheta_iz))/L，其中 z 处的求和有有限支撑。Corollary312Variant(X) 恰指 -Qtotal/(2 ell)≤Rtotal。 对这样的 X，不变量记录 inv 给出自然数 m，满足 $1\le m\le[M:\mathbb Q]$，非负实数 D0、F0，由自然数中的素数组成的有限集合 S，以及函数 k:N→R，满足所有 p 上 k(p)≥0 且 S 外 k(p)=0；它们分别是 emod、logDtpd、logFtpd、dst、logDK 的实际取值。D0、F0 在此记录中是给定数，没有进一步的不同理想或导子定义。令 d0=[M:Q] 为 X.dmod，e=552960m，a=log(e ell)，j(p) 在 p≤e ell 时为 1，否则为 0，Ksum=sum_{p in S}k(p)，Slog=sum_{p in S}log(p)。证书恰要求四项：ell≥7，Bq 中所有 w 的 r_w 均属于 S，Ksum≤D0+F0+2log(ell)+21，以及 Slog≤2d0(D0+F0)+5+log(ell)。令 b(n,p)=n k(p)-(n-1)^2 Q_p/(2ell)+log(p)+4n a j(p)，其中 n 是自然数，但本式中的 n-1 为实数减法。局部估计为每个 i<L 和有理处 z 选取子集 C_iz ⊆ T_iz，要求 C_iz 属于 H_iz，Theta_iz ⊆ C_iz，对 S 外的每个有限素数 p 有 C_i,p=J_i,p，对 S 内的每个有限素数 p 有 V_i,p(C_i,p)≤b(n_i,p)，在无穷处有 V_i,infinity(C_i,infinity)≤n_i log(pi)；还要求对所有 i,z 及 T_iz 中任意两个上述【译名待定：TERM-RMB-001】区域 U、V，只要 U ⊆ V 就有 V_iz(U)≤V_iz(V)，此单调性涉及所有这种区域，并不限于指定子类 H_iz。素数计数记录给出实数 eta>1，要求对每个实数 t≥eta，有 $\pi_{\mathbb N}(\lfloor t\rfloor_{\mathbb N})\le\frac{3t}{2\log t}$，其中 pi_N(n) 是不大于自然数 n 的素数个数，floor_nat 是取值于自然数的下取整。 对每组这样的 A、G、X、inv，若给出上述证书 cert 和一个实际局部估计 est，给出含所选 eta 的素数计数记录，并假设 Corollary312Variant(X)，即 $-\frac{Q_{\mathrm{tot}}}{2\ell}\le R_{\mathrm{tot}}$，则 $\frac{Q_{\mathrm{tot}}}{6}\le\left(1+\frac{20d_0}{\ell}\right)(D_0+F_0)+20(e\ell+\eta)$。定理对这些输入全称量化，不构造或唯一确定它们。结论中除法均为实数除法；证书保证 ell≥7，因此分母非零。不变量记录自身不要求有限集合 S 非空，但证书与 X 的全部条件必须同时成立。
readbacks.ja: 任意の宇宙レベル $u,v$ を取る。与えられたレコード $A$ は、宇宙 $u$ の各体 $k$ に対象の型 $O_k$ を、各対象の対に被覆の型を割り当て、合成可能な被覆の合成演算を与える。各体準同型は対象と被覆の基底変換を与える。各楕円 Weierstrass 曲線は一つの対象を与え、pmQuotient は対象上の指定演算である。各対象には副有限群、各被覆には開埋込みである連続群準同型が指定される。被覆の正方形上、対象の対上（HasCore）、自然数と対象上の二つの述語は与えられた述語である。各対象にはカスプの型とその基底変換が指定される。乗法記法の整数に零を付加した値を取る階数一付値を持つ完備体上では、対象の Tate 構造の型と、自然数・対象・その構造上の述語が与えられる。各対象と自然数には階数一商の型とカスプへの写像が与えられる。$A$ 上の指定レコード $G$ は各対象に群、位相、その副有限群への連続準同型を与え、上記完備階数一付値体上では自然数・対象・$A$ の Tate 構造上の述語、およびその構造を持つ対象の一つのカスプを与える。これらは指定フィールドであり、余分な幾何学的条件や関手性を付加しない。 Corollary312VariantData 型のデータ X は InitialThetaData レコード D とレコード Q,R からなる。D は数体 F、その代数閉包 Fbar、F 上の楕円 Weierstrass 曲線 E を与える。M=Q(E.j) は j 不変量が生成する中間体である。さらに M の有限素点の空でない集合 Vbad が与えられ、その剰余標数は奇数であり、-1 は F の平方、E は F のすべての有限素点で安定還元を持ち、Fbar 上の六等分点は F 上有理であり、Vbad の上にある F の各有限素点で乗法的還元を持つ。選んだ素数 ell は 5 以上であり、選んだ加法的基底は ell 等分点群を (Z/ell Z)^2 と同一視する。Galois 表現はこの基底で作用を表し、その核は開で、像は SL_2(Z/ell Z) の像を含む。F/M は次数が ell と互いに素な Galois 拡大であり、ell は Vbad の各剰余標数と互いに素である。F の各悪い素点では、E の j 不変量の埋込み像を j 値とする Tate パラメータ、一様化元、およびその正整数 q 位数が ell と互いに素であるという条件が与えられる。K は表現の核の固定体である。D は K の数体構造、整合的な M 代数構造とスカラー塔、二つの Galois 同変条件を持つ K 上の TateFamily、OrbicurveData、LocalThetaData も含む。後二者は二つの型述語とコア述語を満たす被覆の指定されたカルテジアン正方形、階数一商から Z/ell Z への全単射、その像が零でない選ばれた商とそのカスプ、M の上にある有限・無限素点の切断、基底変換後のカルテジアン正方形、閉分解部分群、二組の局所 Tate 構造、指定局所型と theta モデルの述語、指定カスプの等式を与える。これらは保持されるデータと条件である。Q は Vbad の上にある F の有限素点をちょうど集めた有限集合 Bq と、その上の正実数の重み a_w を与える。q_w を D の正整数 q 位数、r_w を剰余標数とし、Q_p=sum_{w in Bq,r_w=p} a_w q_w log(r_w)、Qtotal=sum_{w in Bq} a_w q_w log(r_w) と置く。この重みに正規化条件はない。R は K のすべての素点を添字とする容器と有理素点への写像を与え、有限素点の剰余標数を保ち、無限素点を無限素点に送り、各ファイバーは有限である。標準列の長さは L=(ell-1)/2 であり、ここでの減算と除算は自然数の演算である。第 i のラベル集合は {0,...,i+1}、その大きさは n_i=i+2 である。有理素点 z における成分添字 c はこのラベル集合から z 上のファイバーへの関数であり、パケットの台は依存積 T_iz=product_c S_izc である。各 S_izc は位相を備えた指定可換環で、指定部分集合 J_izc を持つ。台はこれらの環の積そのものである。整領域は J_iz=product_c J_izc である。ハル領域とは、各 b_c が単元である product_c b_c J_izc 型の集合である。指定対数殻は閉包がコンパクトな積領域であり、有限個の z を除き J_iz に等しく、有限素点では J_iz を含む。各 i,z のハル系は閉包がコンパクトな許容集合の族、そのハル領域の部分族 H_iz で J_iz を含むもの、および各許容 U を含む H_iz の最小元で再び許容なものを与える。選ばれた theta 領域 Theta_iz は許容で、対数殻に含まれ、有限個の z を除いて J_iz に等しい。体積データは各ファイバー上の総和 1 の正の重み、実数値の成分体積、および任意の部分集合上の実数値パケット体積 V_iz を与える。成分体積は有限素点の指定整部分集合と無限素点の指定球で零であり、有限素数 p では整部分集合の単元倍を p 倍写像で引き戻した集合の成分体積は、その単元倍の体積に log(p) を加えた値である。V_iz(J_iz)=0 であり、各因子が空でない積領域の V_iz はファイバー重みの積で重み付けした成分体積の有限和である。HTheta_iz を Theta_iz の指定最小ハルとし、Rtotal=(sum_{i<L} sum_z V_iz(HTheta_iz))/L と置く。z に関する和は有限の台を持つ。Corollary312Variant(X) はちょうど -Qtotal/(2 ell)≤Rtotal を意味する。 この X の不変量レコード inv は、$1\le m\le[M:\mathbb Q]$ を満たす自然数 m、非負実数 D0,F0、自然数の素数からなる有限集合 S、および全ての p で k(p)≥0、S の外で k(p)=0 を満たす関数 k:N→R を与える。これらは emod,logDtpd,logFtpd,dst,logDK の実際の値であり、D0,F0 readbacks.en: Let $u,v$ be arbitrary universe levels. A supplied record $A$ assigns to every field $k$ in universe $u$ a type $O_k$, to each pair of objects a type of covers, and a composition operation on composable covers. Each field homomorphism gives base change of objects and covers. Every elliptic Weierstrass curve gives an object, and pmQuotient is a supplied operation on objects. Each object has an assigned profinite group, and each cover has an assigned continuous group homomorphism that is an open embedding. There are supplied predicates on squares of covers, pairs of objects (HasCore), and two predicates on natural numbers and objects. Each object has a supplied cusp type, with cusp base change. Over every complete field with a rank-one valuation valued in the multiplicative integers with zero, there are a supplied type of Tate structures on an object and a predicate of a natural number, an object and a Tate structure. Each object and natural number have an assigned rank-one quotient type with a map to the cusps. A supplied record $G$ over $A$ assigns to each object a group, a topology and a continuous homomorphism to its assigned profinite group; over each complete rank-one valued field as above it also assigns a predicate of a natural number, an object and an $A$-Tate structure, and a chosen cusp for each such object and structure. These types, maps and predicates are record fields, with no extra geometric or functoriality assumptions. A datum X of type Corollary312VariantData consists of an InitialThetaData record D, a record Q and a record R. In D, F is a number field, Fbar is an algebraic closure of F, E is an elliptic Weierstrass curve over F, M=Q(E.j) is the intermediate field generated by its j-invariant, and Vbad is a nonempty set of finite places of M with odd residue characteristic; -1 is a square in F, E has stable reduction at every finite place of F, its 6-torsion over Fbar is rational over F, and it has multiplicative reduction at every place of F over Vbad. The chosen prime ell is at least 5; a chosen additive basis identifies its torsion with (Z/ell Z)^2, and the Galois representation realizes the action in that basis, has open kernel and contains the image of SL_2(Z/ell Z). F/M is Galois of degree coprime to ell, and ell is coprime to every residue characteristic in Vbad. At every bad place of F the record supplies a Tate parameter having the embedded j-invariant of E, a uniformizer, and the condition that its positive integral q-order is coprime to ell. K is the fixed field of that representation's kernel. D also includes the number-field and compatible M-algebra/tower structures on K, the TateFamily over K with its two Galois-equivariance conditions, and its OrbicurveData and LocalThetaData: a specified cartesian diagram of covers with the two stated type predicates and core predicate, a rank-one-quotient bijection with Z/ell Z, a chosen quotient with nonzero image and its specified cusp, sections of finite and infinite places lying over M, the base-changed cartesian diagrams, closed decomposition subgroups, the two local Tate structures, the stated local type and theta-model predicates, and the prescribed equality of cusps. These are carried data and conditions. Q chooses exactly the finite places of F over Vbad as a finite set Bq and assigns real weights a_w>0 on Bq. Put q_w equal to the positive integral q-order furnished by D at w, r_w equal to its residue characteristic, Q_p=sum over w in Bq with r_w=p of a_w q_w log(r_w), and Qtotal=sum over w in Bq of a_w q_w log(r_w). No normalization of these Q-weights is stipulated. R supplies a container indexed by all places of K, a map to the rational places compatible with finite residue characteristics and sending infinite places to infinity, finite fibers, and a standard procession of length L=(ell-1)/2, where subtraction and division here are natural-number operations; its i-th label set is {0,...,i+1}, of size n_i=i+2. At rational place z the component index c is a function from that label set to the fiber above z, and its packet carrier is the dependent product T_iz=product over c of S_izc, where each S_izc is a supplied commutative ring with a topology and a specified subset J_izc. In particular these carriers are the supplied products of rings, not an implicitly chosen local field. The integral region is J_iz=product over c of J_izc. A hull region is a set product over c of b_c J_izc with each b_c a unit. The supplied log-shell sets are product regions with compact closure, equal to J_iz away from finitely many z, and contain J_iz at finite z. For each i,z a hull system supplies a class of admissible sets with compact closure, a subclass H_iz of hull regions containing J_iz, and, for an admissible U, its least H_iz-member containing U, again admissible. R chooses a theta region Theta_iz, admissible for this system, inside the log-shell, and equal to J_iz away from finitely many z. Its chosen volume data give positive fiber weights summing to one, real component-volume functions and real packet-volume functions V_iz on arbitrary subsets of these carriers. Component volumes vanish on the finite integral subsets and on specified infinite balls; at a finite prime p the inverse image under multiplication by p of a unit multiple of an integral subset has component volume equal to the latter volume plus log(p). Packet volume vanishes on J_iz, and on a nonempty product region it is the finite sum of the component volumes weighted by the products of the fiber weights. Put HTheta_iz equal to the supplied least hull of Theta_iz and Rtotal=(sum over i<L of the finite-support sum over rational places z of V_iz(HTheta_iz))/L. The proposition Corollary312Variant(X) means exactly -Qtotal/(2 ell)≤Rtotal. For such an X, an invariant record inv chooses a natural number m with $1\le m\le[M:\mathbb Q]$, nonnegative real numbers D0 and F0, a finite set S of natural-number primes, and a function k:N→R with k(p)≥0 for every p and k(p)=0 outside S. These are the actual values of emod, logDtpd, logFtpd, dst and logDK; D0 and F0 are supplied numbers, with no further ideal or conductor definition in this record. Write d0=[M:Q] for X.dmod, e=552960m, a=log(e ell), j(p)=1 if p≤e ell and 0 otherwise, Ksum=sum_{p in S}k(p), and Slog=sum_{p in S}log(p). The certificate means all four conditions ell≥7, every r_w for w in Bq belongs to S, Ksum≤D0+F0+2log(ell)+21, and Slog≤2d0(D0+F0)+5+log(ell). Put b(n,p)=n k(p)-(n-1)^2 Q_p/(2ell)+log(p)+4n a j(p), where n is a natural number but n-1 in this formula is real subtraction. A local estimate is a choice of sets C_iz ⊆ T_iz for every i<L and rational place z such that C_iz belongs to H_iz, Theta_iz is a subset of C_iz, C_i,p=J_i,p for every finite prime p outside S, V_i,p(C_i,p)≤b(n_i,p) for every finite prime p in S, and V_i,infinity(C_i,infinity)≤n_i log(pi). It also requires, for all i,z and every pair of hull regions U,V in T_iz with U ⊆ V, that V_iz(U)≤V_iz(V); this monotonicity hypothesis is on every hull region, not only the chosen class H_iz. A prime-counting record consists of a real eta>1 with $\pi_{\mathbb N}(\lfloor t\rfloor_{\mathbb N})\le\frac{3t}{2\log t}$ for every real t≥eta, where pi_N(n) is the number of natural-number primes at most n and floor_nat is the nonnegative-integer floor. Independently, let T be any HeightTheory record. It supplies a type of curves, a type Pt(Y) for each curve Y, arbitrary predicates Hyperbolic and DivisorFree, sets E_le(Y,n) and E_eq(Y,n) for natural n, with E_le(Y,0) empty and E_le(Y,n+1)=E_le(Y,n) ∪ E_eq(Y,n+1), three real-valued functions htCan_Y, logDiff_Y, logCond_Y on each Pt(Y), a chosen curve t with Hyperbolic(t), a type CBS and a map from CBS to subsets of Pt(t). No further geometry, degree formula, positivity or properness is built into these fields. Fix K0 in CBS and a natural d, write B0=T.cbsSet(K0), U=B0 ∩ E_le(t,d), and write Diff(x)=logDiff_t(x), Cond(x)=logCond_t(x). An input record I consists of h:Pt(t)→R and, for each x in U with its membership proof, local data Lx. A local datum is an arbitrary type J in a universe w, a finite subset Bad of J, functions p,hv,f:J→N and a natural deg≥1; for every j in Bad, p(j) is prime and hv(j),f(j)≥1, and for every natural q, sum over j in Bad with p(j)=q of f(j)≤deg. Put H(L)=(sum_{j in Bad}hv(j)f(j)log(p(j)))/deg, H_q(L)=(sum_{j in Bad,p(j)=q}hv(j)f(j)log(p(j)))/deg, and H_{a,b}^other(L)=(sum_{j in Bad,p(j)≠a,p(j)≠b}hv(j)f(j)log(p(j)))/deg, taking natural values as real in these formulas. I requires H(Lx)=h(x), deg(Lx)≤552960d for all x in U; there exist real c1,c2 such that h(x)/6≤htCan_t(x)+c1 and htCan_t(x)≤h(x)/6+c2 for all x in B0; and for every real H the set {x in U:h(x)≤H} is finite. It chooses a real B≥0 with H_2(Lx)≤B on U, an arbitrary predicate Cyc:Pt(t)→N→Prop, and a real TK. For every x in U and prime ell≥7, if ell divides none of hv(j) for j in Bad(Lx) and Cyc(x,ell) holds, then $\frac{\ell-2}{24}\bigl(h(x)-H_2(L_x)\bigr)\le2\log\ell+T_K$, with ell-2 a real subtraction. It also chooses an arbitrary predicate Image:Pt(t)→N→Prop, such that for every x in U and prime ell≥5, if ell divides none of those hv(j), not Cyc(x,ell), and some j in Bad(Lx) has p(j)≠2 and p(j)≠ell, then Image(x,ell). Finally it supplies a subset Exc of Pt(t) whose intersection with U is finite. Cyc and Image are just the predicates supplied by this record; their names do not impose a subgroup or representation definition. The local finite set may be empty, its index type need not be finite or inhabited, and the three natural-number functions outside Bad have no restrictions. The local denominator cannot be zero. The membership-dependent local data are required for each membership proof. For an arbitrary predicate P on all these X, ThetaDataExistence(P,I) is the proposition with the following single field: for every x in U, every proof hx of this membership and every proof x not in Exc, and then for every natural prime ell≥7, if (i) ell divides none of hv(j) for j in Bad(Lx), (ii) whenever j in Bad(Lx) has p(j)=ell one has hv(j)<sqrt(h(x)) after conversion to real numbers, (iii) some j in Bad(Lx) has p(j)≠2 and p(j)≠ell, and (iv) Image(x,ell) holds, then there exist a datum X and an invariant record inv on X such that P(X), the four certificate conditions above, and nonemptiness of the full local-estimate type above all hold, and such that X.ell=ell, X.dmod≤d, Qtotal(X)=H_{2,ell}^other(Lx), $\operatorname{Diff}(x)=D_0(\mathrm{inv})$, $F_0(\mathrm{inv})\le\operatorname{Cond}(x)$, and $\operatorname{Cond}(x)\le F_0(\mathrm{inv})+\log(2\ell)$. The existential witnesses may depend on x, hx, ell and all the preceding hypotheses; no uniqueness or specified choice is asserted. It does not assume the inequality Corollary312Variant(X) for these witnesses. Here sqrt is the real square root (zero on negative arguments). If U is empty, or no ell satisfies the antecedents at a given x, the corresponding universal implication has no witnesses to supply; in particular d=0 is allowed in this definition and U is then empty by the HeightTheory axiom. All equalities and inequalities written here are conjuncts, not equivalences.

readbacks.en: Let $u,v$ be arbitrary universe levels. A supplied record $A$ assigns to every field $k$ in universe $u$ a type $O_k$, to each pair of objects a type of covers, and a composition operation on composable covers. Each field homomorphism gives base change of objects and covers. Every elliptic Weierstrass curve gives an object, and pmQuotient is a supplied operation on objects. Each object has an assigned profinite group, and each cover has an assigned continuous group homomorphism that is an open embedding. There are supplied predicates on squares of covers, pairs of objects (HasCore), and two predicates on natural numbers and objects. Each object has a supplied cusp type, with cusp base change. Over every complete field with a rank-one valuation valued in the multiplicative integers with zero, there are a supplied type of Tate structures on an object and a predicate of a natural number, an object and a Tate structure. Each object and natural number have an assigned rank-one quotient type with a map to the cusps. A supplied record $G$ over $A$ assigns to each object a group, a topology and a continuous homomorphism to its assigned profinite group; over each complete rank-one valued field as above it also assigns a predicate of a natural number, an object and an $A$-Tate structure, and a chosen cusp for each such object and structure. These types, maps and predicates are record fields, with no extra geometric or functoriality assumptions. A datum X of type Corollary312VariantData consists of an InitialThetaData record D, a record Q and a record R. In D, F is a number field, Fbar is an algebraic closure of F, E is an elliptic Weierstrass curve over F, M=Q(E.j) is the intermediate field generated by its j-invariant, and Vbad is a nonempty set of finite places of M with odd residue characteristic; -1 is a square in F, E has stable reduction at every finite place of F, its 6-torsion over Fbar is rational over F, and it has multiplicative reduction at every place of F over Vbad. The chosen prime ell is at least 5; a chosen additive basis identifies its torsion with (Z/ell Z)^2, and the Galois representation realizes the action in that basis, has open kernel and contains the image of SL_2(Z/ell Z). F/M is Galois of degree coprime to ell, and ell is coprime to every residue characteristic in Vbad. At every bad place of F the record supplies a Tate parameter having the embedded j-invariant of E, a uniformizer, and the condition that its positive integral q-order is coprime to ell. K is the fixed field of that representation's kernel. D also includes the number-field and compatible M-algebra/tower structures on K, the TateFamily over K with its two Galois-equivariance conditions, and its OrbicurveData and LocalThetaData: a specified cartesian diagram of covers with the two stated type predicates and core predicate, a rank-one-quotient bijection with Z/ell Z, a chosen quotient with nonzero image and its specified cusp, sections of finite and infinite places lying over M, the base-changed cartesian diagrams, closed decomposition subgroups, the two local Tate structures, the stated local type and theta-model predicates, and the prescribed equality of cusps. These are carried data and conditions. Q chooses exactly the finite places of F over Vbad as a finite set Bq and assigns real weights a_w>0 on Bq. Put q_w equal to the positive integral q-order furnished by D at w, r_w equal to its residue characteristic, Q_p=sum over w in Bq with r_w=p of a_w q_w log(r_w), and Qtotal=sum over w in Bq of a_w q_w log(r_w). No normalization of these Q-weights is stipulated. R supplies a container indexed by all places of K, a map to the rational places compatible with finite residue characteristics and sending infinite places to infinity, finite fibers, and a standard procession of length L=(ell-1)/2, where subtraction and division here are natural-number operations; its i-th label set is {0,...,i+1}, of size n_i=i+2. At rational place z the component index c is a function from that label set to the fiber above z, and its packet carrier is the dependent product T_iz=product over c of S_izc, where each S_izc is a supplied commutative ring with a topology and a specified subset J_izc. In particular these carriers are the supplied products of rings, not an implicitly chosen local field. The integral region is J_iz=product over c of J_izc. A hull region is a set product over c of b_c J_izc with each b_c a unit. The supplied log-shell sets are product regions with compact closure, equal to J_iz away from finitely many z, and contain J_iz at finite z. For each i,z a hull system supplies a class of admissible sets with compact closure, a subclass H_iz of hull regions containing J_iz, and, for an admissible U, its least H_iz-member containing U, again admissible. R chooses a theta region Theta_iz, admissible for this system, inside the log-shell, and equal to J_iz away from finitely many z. Its chosen volume data give positive fiber weights summing to one, real component-volume functions and real packet-volume functions V_iz on arbitrary subsets of these carriers. Component volumes vanish on the finite integral subsets and on specified infinite balls; at a finite prime p the inverse image under multiplication by p of a unit multiple of an integral subset has component volume equal to the latter volume plus log(p). Packet volume vanishes on J_iz, and on a nonempty product region it is the finite sum of the component volumes weighted by the products of the fiber weights. Put HTheta_iz equal to the supplied least hull of Theta_iz and Rtotal=(sum over i<L of the finite-support sum over rational places z of V_iz(HTheta_iz))/L. The proposition Corollary312Variant(X) means exactly -Qtotal/(2 ell)≤Rtotal. For such an X, an invariant record inv chooses a natural number m with $1\le m\le[M:\mathbb Q]$, nonnegative real numbers D0 and F0, a finite set S of natural-number primes, and a function k:N→R with k(p)≥0 for every p and k(p)=0 outside S. These are the actual values of emod, logDtpd, logFtpd, dst and logDK; D0 and F0 are supplied numbers, with no further ideal or conductor definition in this record. lemma sum_union_le_of_nonneg {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (s t : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℝ)

    ∑ k ∈ s.biUnion t, f k ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, ∑ k ∈ t i, f k := by

  induction s using Finset.induction_on with

    ∃ p : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ p ∉ A ∧ (p : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (thetaSet A + cheb.ξ) := by

  have hlow := cheb.lower x hxξ

    have hple : (p : ℝ) ≤ x := by

        _ ≤ x := Nat.floor_le (by linarith)

    exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsub fun p _ _ => log_natCast_nonneg p

  linarith [thetaSet_nonneg A]

  have hopen : IsOpen (P.torsionField.fixingSubgroup : Set (Fbar ≃ₐ[F] Fbar)) :=

    NumberField ↥(IntermediateField.fixedField H) := by
  have hle : H ≤ (IntermediateField.fixedField H).fixingSubgroup :=

  have hopen : IsOpen ((IntermediateField.fixedField H).fixingSubgroup :

  have : FiniteDimensional F ↥(IntermediateField.fixedField H) :=
    (InfiniteGalois.isOpen_iff_finite _).mp hopen
  have : CharZero ↥(IntermediateField.fixedField H) :=
    charZero_of_injective_algebraMap (algebraMap F ↥(IntermediateField.fixedField H)).injective

structure DirectSumPresentation (C : Type u) : Type (max u (v + 1)) where
  
  Summand : C → Type v
  


  [ring_summand : ∀ c, CommRing (Summand c)]
  

  [topology_summand : ∀ c, TopologicalSpace (Summand c)]
  


  integral : ∀ c, Set (Summand c)

attribute [instance] DirectSumPresentation.ring_summand
  DirectSumPresentation.topology_summand

namespace DirectSumPresentation

variable {C : Type u} (P : DirectSumPresentation.{u, v} C)



def Total : Type (max u v) := ∀ c, P.Summand c

instance : TopologicalSpace P.Total := inferInstanceAs (TopologicalSpace (∀ c, P.Summand c))



def integralRegion : Set P.Total := {x | ∀ c, x c ∈ P.integral c}

@[simp]
lemma mem_integralRegion {x : P.Total} : x ∈ P.integralRegion ↔ ∀ c, x c ∈ P.integral c :=
  Iff.rfl




def IsProductRegion (R : Set P.Total) : Prop :=
  ∃ U : ∀ c, Set (P.Summand c), R = {x | ∀ c, x c ∈ U c}


def productRegion (U : ∀ c, Set (P.Summand c)) : Set P.Total := {x | ∀ c, x c ∈ U c}

@[simp]
lemma mem_productRegion {U : ∀ c, Set (P.Summand c)} {x : P.Total} :
    x ∈ P.productRegion U ↔ ∀ c, x c ∈ U c := Iff.rfl

lemma isProductRegion_productRegion (U : ∀ c, Set (P.Summand c)) :
    P.IsProductRegion (P.productRegion U) := ⟨U, rfl⟩

lemma isProductRegion_integralRegion : P.IsProductRegion P.integralRegion :=
  ⟨fun c => P.integral c, rfl⟩




def IsBorelRegion (R : Set P.Total) : Prop := @MeasurableSet P.Total (borel P.Total) R




def scaledIntegral (a : P.Total) : Set P.Total :=
  {x | ∀ c, x c ∈ a c • P.integral c}

@[simp]
lemma mem_scaledIntegral {a x : P.Total} :
    x ∈ P.scaledIntegral a ↔ ∀ c, x c ∈ a c • P.integral c :=
  Iff.rfl

lemma isProductRegion_scaledIntegral (a : P.Total) :
    P.IsProductRegion (P.scaledIntegral a) :=
  ⟨fun c => a c • P.integral c, rfl⟩

@[simp]
lemma scaledIntegral_one : P.scaledIntegral (fun _ => 1) = P.integralRegion := by
  ext x
  simp [scaledIntegral, integralRegion]




def IsHullRegion (R : Set P.Total) : Prop :=
  ∃ a : P.Total, (∀ c, IsUnit (a c)) ∧ R = P.scaledIntegral a

lemma isHullRegion_integralRegion : P.IsHullRegion P.integralRegion :=
  ⟨fun _ => 1, fun _ => isUnit_one, (P.scaledIntegral_one).symm⟩

end DirectSumPresentation

def IsLeastHullRegionIn (P : DirectSumPresentation C) (𝓗 : Set (Set P.Total))
    (U R : Set P.Total) : Prop :=
  R ∈ 𝓗 ∧ U ⊆ R ∧ ∀ R' ∈ 𝓗, U ⊆ R' → R ⊆ R'


lemma IsLeastHullRegionIn.unique {𝓗 : Set (Set P.Total)} {U R₁ R₂ : Set P.Total}
    (h₁ : P.IsLeastHullRegionIn 𝓗 U R₁) (h₂ : P.IsLeastHullRegionIn 𝓗 U R₂) : R₁ = R₂ :=
  Set.Subset.antisymm (h₁.2.2 R₂ h₂.1 h₂.2.1) (h₂.2.2 R₁ h₁.1 h₁.2.1)



def IsLeastHullRegion (P : DirectSumPresentation C) (U R : Set P.Total) : Prop :=
  P.IsLeastHullRegionIn {R | P.IsHullRegion R} U R


lemma IsLeastHullRegion.unique {U R₁ R₂ : Set P.Total}
    (h₁ : P.IsLeastHullRegion U R₁) (h₂ : P.IsLeastHullRegion U R₂) : R₁ = R₂ :=
  IsLeastHullRegionIn.unique h₁ h₂

end DirectSumPresentation

structure HullSystem {C : Type u} (P : DirectSumPresentation.{u, v} C) :
    Type (max u v) where
  


  Admissible : Set (Set P.Total)
  

  relCompact_of_admissible : ∀ U ∈ Admissible, IsCompact (closure U)
  


  HullRegions : Set (Set P.Total)
  
  isHullRegion_of_mem : ∀ R ∈ HullRegions, P.IsHullRegion R
  
  integralRegion_mem : P.integralRegion ∈ HullRegions
  
  hull : Set P.Total → Set P.Total
  

  isLeastHullRegion_hull : ∀ U ∈ Admissible, P.IsLeastHullRegionIn HullRegions U (hull U)
  

  hull_admissible : ∀ U ∈ Admissible, hull U ∈ Admissible

namespace HullSystem

variable {C : Type u} {P : DirectSumPresentation.{u, v} C} (H : HullSystem P)
variable {U V : Set P.Total}


lemma hull_mem_hullRegions (hU : U ∈ H.Admissible) : H.hull U ∈ H.HullRegions :=
  (H.isLeastHullRegion_hull U hU).1


lemma isHullRegion_hull (hU : U ∈ H.Admissible) : P.IsHullRegion (H.hull U) :=
  H.isHullRegion_of_mem _ (H.hull_mem_hullRegions hU)


lemma subset_hull (hU : U ∈ H.Admissible) : U ⊆ H.hull U :=
  (H.isLeastHullRegion_hull U hU).2.1



lemma hull_le (hU : U ∈ H.Admissible) {R : Set P.Total}
    (hR : R ∈ H.HullRegions) (hUR : U ⊆ R) : H.hull U ⊆ R :=
  (H.isLeastHullRegion_hull U hU).2.2 R hR hUR



theorem hull_eq_self (hU : U ∈ H.Admissible) (h : U ∈ H.HullRegions) : H.hull U = U :=
  Set.Subset.antisymm (H.hull_le hU h subset_rfl) (H.subset_hull hU)



theorem hull_mono (hU : U ∈ H.Admissible) (hV : V ∈ H.Admissible) (hUV : U ⊆ V) :
    H.hull U ⊆ H.hull V :=
  H.hull_le hU (H.hull_mem_hullRegions hV) (hUV.trans (H.subset_hull hV))


theorem hull_idem (hU : U ∈ H.Admissible) : H.hull (H.hull U) = H.hull U :=
  H.hull_eq_self (H.hull_admissible U hU) (H.hull_mem_hullRegions hU)





theorem hull_eq_sInter (hU : U ∈ H.Admissible) :
    H.hull U = ⋂₀ {R : Set P.Total | R ∈ H.HullRegions ∧ U ⊆ R} := by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · exact Set.subset_sInter fun R hR => H.hull_le hU hR.1 hR.2
  · exact Set.sInter_subset_of_mem ⟨H.hull_mem_hullRegions hU, H.subset_hull hU⟩


abbrev AdmissibleRegionType := {U : Set P.Total // U ∈ H.Admissible}




def closureOperator : ClosureOperator H.AdmissibleRegionType :=
  ClosureOperator.mk' (fun U => ⟨H.hull U.1, H.hull_admissible U.1 U.2⟩)
    (fun U V hUV => H.hull_mono U.2 V.2 hUV)
    (fun U => H.subset_hull U.2)
    (fun U => le_of_eq (Subtype.ext (H.hull_idem U.2)))

@[simp]
lemma closureOperator_apply (U : H.AdmissibleRegionType) :
    (H.closureOperator U : Set P.Total) = H.hull U.1 := rfl



lemma hull_eq_hull (H' : HullSystem P) (h : H.Admissible = H'.Admissible)
    (h𝓗 : H.HullRegions = H'.HullRegions) (hU : U ∈ H.Admissible) : H.hull U = H'.hull U :=
  (H.isLeastHullRegion_hull U hU).unique
    (h𝓗 ▸ H'.isLeastHullRegion_hull U (h ▸ hU))

end HullSystem







noncomputable def HullSystem.ofExists {C : Type u} (P : DirectSumPresentation.{u, v} C)
    (A : Set (Set P.Total)) (relCompact : ∀ U ∈ A, IsCompact (closure U))
    (𝓗 : Set (Set P.Total)) (isHullRegion_of_mem : ∀ R ∈ 𝓗, P.IsHullRegion R)
    (integralRegion_mem : P.integralRegion ∈ 𝓗)
    (exists_least : ∀ U ∈ A, ∃ R, P.IsLeastHullRegionIn 𝓗 U R)
    (least_admissible : ∀ U ∈ A, ∀ R, P.IsLeastHullRegionIn 𝓗 U R → R ∈ A) :
    HullSystem P where
  Admissible := A
  relCompact_of_admissible := relCompact
  HullRegions := 𝓗
  isHullRegion_of_mem := isHullRegion_of_mem
  integralRegion_mem := integralRegion_mem
  hull U := open Classical in
    if hU : U ∈ A then (exists_least U hU).choose else Set.univ
  isLeastHullRegion_hull U hU := by
    simpa [hU] using (exists_least U hU).choose_spec
  hull_admissible U hU := by
    simpa [hU] using least_admissible U hU _ (exists_least U hU).choose_spec

variable {α β : Type*}




def DiscrepancyLE (f g : α → ℝ) (s : Set α) : Prop :=
  ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ s, f x ≤ g x + C




def DiscrepancyEquiv (f g : α → ℝ) (s : Set α) : Prop :=
  DiscrepancyLE f g s ∧ DiscrepancyLE g f s

@[inherit_doc]
notation:50 f:51 " ≲[" s "] " g:51 => DiscrepancyLE f g s

@[inherit_doc]
notation:50 f:51 " ≈[" s "] " g:51 => DiscrepancyEquiv f g s

namespace DiscrepancyLE

variable {f f₁ f₂ g g₁ g₂ h : α → ℝ} {s t : Set α}

theorem of_forall_le (hfg : ∀ x ∈ s, f x ≤ g x) : f ≲[s] g :=
  ⟨0, fun x hx ↦ by simpa using hfg x hx⟩

protected theorem refl (f : α → ℝ) (s : Set α) : f ≲[s] f :=
  of_forall_le fun _ _ ↦ le_rfl

protected theorem trans (h₁ : f ≲[s] g) (h₂ : g ≲[s] h) : f ≲[s] h := by
  obtain ⟨C₁, hC₁⟩ := h₁
  obtain ⟨C₂, hC₂⟩ := h₂
  exact ⟨C₁ + C₂, fun x hx ↦ by have := hC₁ x hx; have := hC₂ x hx; linarith⟩

theorem mono (hst : t ⊆ s) (hfg : f ≲[s] g) : f ≲[t] g := by
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hfg
  exact ⟨C, fun x hx ↦ hC x (hst hx)⟩

@[simp]
theorem empty : f ≲[(∅ : Set α)] g :=
  ⟨0, by simp⟩

theorem union (hs : f ≲[s] g) (ht : f ≲[t] g) : f ≲[s ∪ t] g := by
  obtain ⟨C₁, hC₁⟩ := hs
  obtain ⟨C₂, hC₂⟩ := ht
  refine ⟨max C₁ C₂, fun x hx ↦ ?_⟩
  rcases hx with hx | hx
  · exact (hC₁ x hx).trans (by gcongr; exact le_max_left C₁ C₂)
  · exact (hC₂ x hx).trans (by gcongr; exact le_max_right C₁ C₂)

protected theorem add (h₁ : f₁ ≲[s] g₁) (h₂ : f₂ ≲[s] g₂) : f₁ + f₂ ≲[s] g₁ + g₂ := by
  obtain ⟨C₁, hC₁⟩ := h₁
  obtain ⟨C₂, hC₂⟩ := h₂
  refine ⟨C₁ + C₂, fun x hx ↦ ?_⟩
  have := hC₁ x hx
  have := hC₂ x hx
  simp only [Pi.add_apply]
  linarith

protected theorem smul {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hfg : f ≲[s] g) : c • f ≲[s] c • g := by
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hfg
  refine ⟨c * C, fun x hx ↦ ?_⟩
  simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  calc c * f x ≤ c * (g x + C) := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hC x hx) hc
    _ = c * g x + c * C := by ring

theorem sub_right (hfg : f ≲[s] g) (h : α → ℝ) : f - h ≲[s] g - h := by
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hfg
  refine ⟨C, fun x hx ↦ ?_⟩
  have := hC x hx
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply]
  linarith

theorem add_right (hfg : f ≲[s] g) (h : α → ℝ) : f + h ≲[s] g + h := by
  simpa using hfg.add (DiscrepancyLE.refl h s)


theorem comp (hfg : f ≲[s] g) (φ : β → α) {t : Set β} (hφ : Set.MapsTo φ t s) :
    f ∘ φ ≲[t] g ∘ φ := by
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hfg
  exact ⟨C, fun x hx ↦ hC (φ x) (hφ hx)⟩



theorem of_comp_surjOn {φ : β → α} {t : Set β} (hφ : Set.SurjOn φ t s)
    (hfg : f ∘ φ ≲[t] g ∘ φ) : f ≲[s] g := by
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hfg
  refine ⟨C, fun x hx ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hφ hx
  exact hC y hy

end DiscrepancyLE

namespace DiscrepancyEquiv

variable {f f₁ f₂ g g₁ g₂ h : α → ℝ} {s t : Set α}

theorem le (hfg : f ≈[s] g) : f ≲[s] g := hfg.1

theorem ge (hfg : f ≈[s] g) : g ≲[s] f := hfg.2

protected theorem refl (f : α → ℝ) (s : Set α) : f ≈[s] f :=
  ⟨.refl f s, .refl f s⟩

protected theorem symm (hfg : f ≈[s] g) : g ≈[s] f :=
  ⟨hfg.2, hfg.1⟩

protected theorem trans (h₁ : f ≈[s] g) (h₂ : g ≈[s] h) : f ≈[s] h :=
  ⟨h₁.le.trans h₂.le, h₂.ge.trans h₁.ge⟩

theorem mono (hst : t ⊆ s) (hfg : f ≈[s] g) : f ≈[t] g :=
  ⟨hfg.le.mono hst, hfg.ge.mono hst⟩

protected theorem add (h₁ : f₁ ≈[s] g₁) (h₂ : f₂ ≈[s] g₂) : f₁ + f₂ ≈[s] g₁ + g₂ :=
  ⟨h₁.le.add h₂.le, h₁.ge.add h₂.ge⟩

protected theorem smul {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hfg : f ≈[s] g) : c • f ≈[s] c • g :=
  ⟨hfg.le.smul hc, hfg.ge.smul hc⟩

theorem sub_right (hfg : f ≈[s] g) (h : α → ℝ) : f - h ≈[s] g - h :=
  ⟨hfg.le.sub_right h, hfg.ge.sub_right h⟩

theorem comp (hfg : f ≈[s] g) (φ : β → α) {t : Set β} (hφ : Set.MapsTo φ t s) :
    f ∘ φ ≈[t] g ∘ φ :=
  ⟨hfg.le.comp φ hφ, hfg.ge.comp φ hφ⟩

end DiscrepancyEquiv

namespace DiscrepancyLE

variable {f g h : α → ℝ} {s : Set α}

theorem trans_equiv (h₁ : f ≲[s] g) (h₂ : g ≈[s] h) : f ≲[s] h :=
  h₁.trans h₂.le

theorem equiv_trans (h₁ : f ≈[s] g) (h₂ : g ≲[s] h) : f ≲[s] h :=
  h₁.le.trans h₂

end DiscrepancyLE
